Where the jobs are, and where the workers sleep

Every tract in Brunswick, Columbus, New Hanover, Pender, coloured by one number: the jobs located in it minus the employed people living in it. Orange means more jobs than resident workers, an employment centre. Blue means more resident workers than jobs, a place people leave in the morning.

More workers than jobs More jobs than workers

130 tracts. 195,899 jobs and 208,233 employed residents, 2023. Hover or focus a tract for its numbers.

Who leaves to work

32%of employed New Hanover County residents leave the county for work. 31,319 of 99,059.
59%of employed Brunswick County residents leave the county for work. 30,590 of 52,054.
78%of employed Pender County residents leave the county for work. 20,163 of 25,707.
60%of employed Columbus County residents leave the county for work. 11,739 of 19,405.
